svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slider: a steel bar 5 thick, 34 wide for its lower 25.5 mm and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 wide for the 10.5 mm above (file the steps), 36 long in all.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File the lower end to a 45 degree ramp across the full 5 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sloping up toward the lid side, to match the pawl's ramp.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill and tap M3, 6 deep, in the top end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Button: print 30 x 16 x 8 in the same plastic as the handle, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 3.4 hole through, counterbored from the top for the screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the slider goes up through the tray top from inside, flat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: against the back wall; the wide part stops under the tray top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so it cannot come out. The button screws on top, 8 above it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press: the ramp wedges between the wall and the pawl and pulls

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pawl in 5 mm. The pawl springs push it back up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 5 mm of button travel retracts the tooth flush.
